description: Navigate the Eurostat theme tree, for discovery when you know the domain but not the dataset code; eurostat_search_datasets finds datasets by keyword. Without theme_code it returns the top-level theme folders, with one that folder's immediate subfolders and datasets. The tree is the dissemination table of contents plus the Comext host's DS-* collections: detailed trade under ext_go_detail (in ext_go) and PRODCOM under prom (in icts). A collection on neither, such as the legacy PRODCOM DS-056120, is not disseminated and appears nowhere in the tree.

theme_code.description: Folder code to expand (e.g., "economy", "reg"), matched exactly, then ignoring case. Omit for the top-level folders.

name: eurostat_browse_themes

catalogueLoadedAt.description: When the catalogue that answered was loaded (ISO 8601); present only when a failed refresh left that older copy in service.

comextListMissing.description: True on a browse of ext_go or icts when the Comext dataflow list could not be loaded, so its DS-* collection folder is not listed. Omitted otherwise.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: theme_code is not in the catalogue, or is a Comext folder (ext_go_detail, prom, comext) or DS-* code while the Comext list cannot be loaded. `not_a_folder`: theme_code names a dataset or table, not a folder. `upstream_fault`: No catalogue was loaded yet and Eurostat's table of contents could not be read: marked retryable after a timeout, rate limit, server error or unreachable host on every retry, not after a refusal Eurostat would repeat. Once a catalogue is loaded, a failed refresh serves that copy instead. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

itemCount.description: Number of items at this level.

items.description: Immediate children of theme_code, or the root themes without it.
A theme folder, dataset, or table entry.

code.description: A folder code to pass as theme_code, or a dataset code for eurostat_get_dataset_info.

dataEnd.description: Latest period; omitted for folders and when not reported.

dataStart.description: Earliest period (e.g., "1995"); omitted for folders and when not reported.

hasChildren.description: True when a folder holds sub-items.

lastUpdated.description: Date of the last data update (e.g., "22.05.2026"); omitted for folders and when not reported.

obsCount.description: Approximate observation count; omitted for folders and when not reported.

type.description: Entry type: "folder", or a queryable "dataset" or "table".

nextStep.description: Suggested next call, when one is clear.

notice.description: Names any part of the catalogue missing from this listing and what to do about it.

otherPlacements.description: Breadcrumbs of other branches filing this same folder code. items come from the first branch the catalogue lists, which never has fewer children but can list different ones; reach the others by browsing down from the root. Omitted for a code with one placement.

items.description: Breadcrumb from the root to one other folder carrying the code.

parentPath.description: Breadcrumb from the root to theme_code; empty at the root.

themeCode.description: Folder code browsed; omitted at the root.

title: Browse Eurostat Theme Hierarchy
